item.description: The year 2003 was marked by the United States invasion of Iraq and the subsequent period of occupation and insurgency. The Kashmir conflict also saw a period of escalation, and the Second Intifada continued in Israel and Palestine.

item.title: 2003 in the United States - Wikipedia
item.description: The Florida Marlins defeat the New York Yankees in six games in the 2003 World Series to win their second World Series title. The Cedar Fire begins in San Diego County, burning 280,000 acres (1,100 km 2), 2,232 homes and killing 14.

item.title: 2003 - Simple English Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia
item.description: 2003 (MMIII) was a common year starting on Wednesday of the Gregorian calendar, the 2003rd year of the Common Era (CE) and Anno Domini (AD) designations, the 3rd year of the 3rd millennium, the 3rd year of the 21st century, and the 4th year of the 2000s decade.

item.description: Email spam became a growing problem in 2003, leading to legislation in several countries. The year 2003 tied with 2002 as the second-hottest year on record.

item.description: In 2003, key events included the Rose Revolution in Georgia, the Eurovision Song Contest, and the FIFA Women's World Cup. The year also had the Formula One World Championship and the first Junior Eurovision Song Contest.
